title: User Registration with Valid Role Selection and Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Verify that users can register with valid data, select their role appropriately, and complete multi-factor authentication for account activation.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Fill in valid user details including username, email, and password
Select an appropriate user role (Technician, Client, Company, or Administrator)
Submit the registration form
Receive multi-factor authentication challenge (e.g., email/SMS code)
Enter the correct multi-factor authentication code
Confirm registration success and that the user can log in with their credentials

title: Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify that the system denies login attempts with incorrect username or password and displays appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input incorrect username or password
Attempt to log in
Check the login is rejected with an informative error message

title: Role-Based Access Control Verification
description: Verify that users can access only features and pages appropriate to their assigned roles and unauthorized access is prevented.

steps.description: Log in as a Technician
Verify that Technician-specific features are accessible
Attempt to access Admin Panel features and confirm access is denied
Log in as an Administrator
Verify full access to Admin Panel and management interfaces
Log in as a Client
Verify only client-related features such as job posting and project tracking are accessible

title: Multi-Step Job Posting with Valid Data and Intelligent Matching
description: Verify that Clients can successfully complete multi-step job posting forms and that the system triggers AI-powered smart matching of jobs to suitable technicians.

steps.description: Log in as a Client
Navigate to the Post Job section
Complete Step 1: Enter job details (title, description)
Complete Step 2: Specify job type and requirements
Complete Step 3: Set salary and payment details
Complete Step 4: Provide job location details
Complete remaining steps with attachments and contact information
Submit the job posting
Confirm job is listed and AI matching process initiates
Verify matched technicians receive appropriate notifications about job opportunity

title: Job Application Flow for Technicians Including Status Tracking
description: Verify that Technicians can browse available jobs, apply correctly, and track application status throughout the process.

steps.description: Log in as a Technician
Navigate to job browsing interface
Search and view the details of a job
Submit an application for the selected job
Confirm application is accepted and status updates are displayed
Check application status updates over time (e.g., Pending, Accepted, Rejected)
Verify status changes trigger appropriate notifications

title: Real-Time Chat Functionality including File Sharing and Audio Calls
description: Test real-time chat features for sending and receiving messages, sharing files successfully, and conducting audio calls without significant delay or loss.

steps.description: Log in as User A and User B in parallel sessions
User A opens chat with User B
User A sends a text message
User B receives the text message instantly
User A uploads and sends a supported file type
User B receives and can open/download the file
User A initiates an audio call to User B
User B receives and accepts the call, audio is clear and stable
User A ends the call
Call ends and appropriate chat history updates are logged

title: Digital Wallet Top-Up with KYC Verification
description: Ensure that users can successfully perform wallet top-ups and that KYC (Know Your Customer) verification rules are enforced before enabling wallet transactions.

steps.description: Log in as a User with an unverified KYC status
Attempt to perform a wallet top-up
Transaction is blocked and user is prompted to complete KYC verification
Submit valid KYC documents and complete verification process
KYC status updates to verified
Perform wallet top-up with valid payment method
Top-up transaction is successful and wallet balance updates accordingly

title: Project Management: Creation, Task Assignment, and Status Tracking
description: Verify that users with appropriate roles can create projects, assign tasks to team members, and that project and task statuses update correctly and are visible to stakeholders.

steps.description: Log in as a Client or Company Manager
Create a new project with valid information
Project is listed in the dashboard and visible to assigned users
Assign tasks to technicians or team members
Assigned users receive task notifications or alerts
Technician updates task status (e.g., In Progress, Completed)
Project dashboard reflects task status changes in real-time

title: Audit Logs Capture Critical System Actions with Traceability
description: Verify that all critical actions within the system are logged properly with required details for traceability and can be retrieved via admin audit log interfaces.

steps.description: Perform key actions such as user login, job postings, payments, and profile updates
Log in as an Administrator and navigate to the audit logs section
Audit logs reflect all performed actions with accurate timestamps, user IDs, and operation details
Audit logs support filtering by date, user, and action type

title: File Upload Handling with Format and Size Validation on Chat and Job Attachments
description: Ensure that file uploads conform to accepted formats and size limits on chat messages and job postings, and errors are handled gracefully when requirements are violated.

steps.description: Attempt to upload a valid file within size limits in chat and job posting components
File uploads successfully and is accessible by recipients or job details
Attempt to upload a file exceeding size limits and/or unsupported format
Upload is rejected with an informative error message and no data corruption occurs

title: Notification System Sends Real-Time Alerts for Job Updates, Messages, and Payments
description: Verify that users receive real-time notifications for important events such as job status changes, new chat messages, and payment confirmations on supported devices.

steps.description: Trigger a job update event (e.g., status change)
Relevant users receive real-time notifications
Send a chat message from one user to another
Recipient receives instant notification
Complete a wallet payment transaction
User receives payment confirmation notification promptly

title: Advanced Search Feature Returns Accurate and Filtered Results
description: Verify that the advanced search functionality delivers accurate and relevant data for queries including job listings, users, companies, and projects with appropriate filters applied.

steps.description: Navigate to the search page
Input search criteria with various filters (e.g., job type, location, date)
Search results match the criteria and are relevant
Perform empty or invalid search queries
System handles gracefully without errors and displays appropriate messages

title: Security Mechanisms Prevent Unauthorized Data Access and Data Leakage
description: Test system security by attempting to access restricted data or perform unauthorized operations ensuring compliance with data protection regulations.

steps.description: Attempt unauthorized API access using invalid or expired JWT tokens
Access is denied and appropriate error codes returned
Try to view or manipulate data outside user role permissions
Operation is prohibited and logged for auditing
Check that sensitive user data is masked or encrypted in responses

title: Public Landing Page Displays Marketing Content and Call-to-Action Correctly
description: Verify that the public facing landing page loads successfully, shows marketing features, testimonials, and call-to-action buttons, and is responsive across devices.

steps.description: Navigate to the public landing page
Verify marketing sections including features, how it works, testimonials, and trusted clients are present and formatted correctly
Call-to-action buttons respond with expected navigation or modal dialogs
Resize browser or view on mobile device
Page layout adjusts appropriately and remains user friendly

title: Scheduling & Calendar Job Planning and Management Accuracy
description: Ensure that the scheduling and calendar system allows users to plan, edit, and view job timelines accurately and reflects real-time updates.

steps.description: Open the scheduling calendar view
Create a new job event with required details
Job appears correctly on the intended date and time slot
Modify or delete the scheduled job
Calendar updates reflect changes instantly

title: Testimonial Submission and Display Functionality
description: Verify that authenticated users can submit testimonials and that these testimonials are displayed accurately on the public landing page's testimonial section.

steps.description: Log in as a verified user
Navigate to testimonial submission form
Submit a valid testimonial with rating and comments
Submission is accepted and confirmed
Visit the public landing page testimonial section
Newly submitted testimonial appears correctly with user details and rating
